forces: The tracker named as canonical in agent-facing documentation recorded 1 of 114 merged pull requests over five days and moved one card while 36 issues closed, so every agent reading CLAUDE.md was directed at a surface that does not carry execution state.

The triage mapping justifies itself with a factual claim that four of the five canonical role labels do not exist in the GitHub label set, while all five exist and carry 82 applications, so an agent following it sets state nobody reads and leaves the labels that are actually filtered on untouched.

Both make targets that claim repository-wide coverage omit one of the five declared workspaces and then report success with a hand-maintained count consistent with the recipe rather than the repository, so a local loop certifies code it never ran while CI covers that package fully.

The repository already learned that an explicit list needs a completeness assertion, because adding a thing and forgetting to list it fails silently, and the governance specification requires a repository-state claim with no enforcing gate to gain a gate rather than a prose assertion.

Governance-core documentation edits must be batched into a dedicated documentation change rather than riding along with bounded implementation work, so these corrections cannot be folded into the delivery changes that surfaced them.

The ratified ci-topology specification itself requires the root command surface to run four named workspaces, omitting the collector, so correcting the Makefile without a MODIFIED delta would put the implementation in contradiction with a canonical requirement.

security_justification.audit_integrity: Closes a path by which a local product loop reported success across workspaces it never executed, so a change to the collector could reach a pull request having been certified by a loop that did not run it.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Changes no authentication or authorization behaviour; the change edits documentation, a Makefile, and a repository-script gate, and touches no runtime code path.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Records the tracker statement as a delegated decision naming its provenance in the file itself, so a later reader cannot mistake it for a human owner decision, and states plainly that the delegated statement is not owner authorization.
security_justification.concurrency: Introduces no concurrent behaviour; the coverage assertion is a pure function over Makefile text and a declared package list, evaluated once per invocation.
security_justification.confidentiality: Processes only repository file contents and public issue and label metadata; no credential, payload, personal data, or customer content enters any file, diagnostic, or test fixture.
security_justification.cryptography: Introduces no cryptography and makes no integrity claim requiring any.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Every new failure is a named diagnostic identifying the target and the uncovered workspace, carrying no file content beyond the workspace path already declared in the repository.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Adds no exporter, collector, SIEM, or external integration; the new assertion runs inside the existing governance job and reaches no network.
security_justification.fail_posture: Fails closed in both directions: an uncovered workspace fails, an absent covering target fails rather than passing vacuously, and the shallow recipe parse errs toward reporting a covered workspace as uncovered rather than the reverse.
security_justification.lifecycle: Adds no runtime lifecycle; the gate is invoked by an existing CI step and by the local command surface, and holds no state between invocations.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Confined to the Makefile, the package-discovery gate and its test, the two agent documentation files, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and this change directory. No contract, package source, generated artifact, or workflow file is written.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Performs no transformation of personal data; the measurements recorded are counts of pull requests, issues, and labels, with no author, actor, or identifier retained.
security_justification.resource_retention: Retains nothing; counts quoted in the documentation are dated observations rather than stored state, and the gate holds no data between runs.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No delivery, retry, or redelivery behaviour is involved; the gate is deterministic over its inputs, so re-running it on unchanged inputs yields the same verdict.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Moves the boundary of the local loop's claim from a hand-maintained literal to an executable assertion, and states plainly that the coverage gate proves each declared workspace is invoked, not that any workspace's own validation is adequate.
